beedie-beedie:lever:11102926-0d70-42cc-9.title: Manager, Real Estate Finance
beedie-beedie:lever:11102926-0d70-42cc-9.description: At Beedie, we foster talent, encourage innovation, and reward success. We’re always looking for like-minded people to join our team and share our passion for doing the best work of our lives. Our approach is simple: we work hard, we have fun, and we make a difference. And, we’ve been recognized as a top employer provincially and nationally. Our people are the heart and soul of our organization. If you are passionate, hardworking, ambitious, and want to be part of a dynamic and growing company that will take your career forward, join us. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Finance and Treasury, the Manager, Real Estate Finance will be responsible for independently managing debt financing processes from initial lender outreach through closing, across Beedie’s diverse real estate portfolio. Core financing duties include asset underwriting, financial analysis, preparation of lender materials, through to deal negotiation, documentation, and funding. The role requires a collaborative and proactive approach to effectively maintain and develop relationships with Beedie’s lending partners and internal business units. The role will also support treasury, cash management, financial modelling, and other strategic finance initiatives as required.
responsibilities: Financings & Analysis
Manage debt financing for stabilized income-producing properties, industrial and residential development properties and land
Prepare financing packages, RFPs and lender presentations in line with the requirements and objectives of the asset, portfolio and ownership
Manage lender outreach and financing timelines
Coordinate with legal counsel on all key loan deliverables
Negotiate term sheets, commitment letters, security packages, recourse provisions and other key financing terms
Oversee loan CP’s and funding requirements

Collaborate with acquisition, construction, development, property and asset management teams to develop financing inputs and analysis to support financing and other business decisions and align with proformas, budgets and forecasts
Support due diligence process for new acquisitions by sourcing financing term sheets and aligning on financing assumptions in the acquisition proforma
Develop and maintain relationships with banks and lenders, while also serving as a liaison across internal teams for their banking and financing requirements
Financial Analysis and Capital Management
Support strategic finance initiatives, including financial modelling, lender reporting, portfolio analysis, and ad hoc transaction support
Develop strategies to maximize efficiencies and minimize borrowing costs, including making the most efficient usage of the various loan facilities
Recommend and implement improvements to the cash management operations
qualifications: University degree in Real Estate, Finance, Commerce, or a related field
Minimum 3-5 years of relevant experience in borrower or lender side real estate finance, banking, or corporate/project finance
Lender or borrower side experience executing financings for variety of real estate assets
Strong understanding of real estate fundamentals, valuation principles, proformas, and deal underwriting
Excellent communicator — able to convey complex concepts clearly and concisely to varied audiences
Strong financial modelling with advanced Excel skills and proficiency using Microsoft Office Suite
Highly organized, results-driven, and comfortable managing multiple projects in a fast-paced environment

getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:dae4bd88-a6c.title: Sales Enablement Trainer
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:dae4bd88-a6c.description: Wing Assistant is hiring a hands on Sales Enablement Trainer to level up our sales team — not with generic intro decks, but by improving the actual emails, calls, and cadences our reps use every day. This is a coach who has carried a quota and closed, and uses that credibility to make real, measurable improvements on the floor. If your first instinct when a deal stalls is "let me see the thread and the call recording" — read on.
responsibilities: Sit in the calls — live and recorded — and find exactly where deals are being lost.
Rewrite the copy, scripts, and sequences that aren't converting, and prove the new version works.
A/B test sales emails, call openers, demo pitches, and tactics like personalized video — keep the winners, kill the losers.
Build and tune outbound cadences so reps follow up at the right time, on the right channel, with the right message.
Coach reps one-on-one on real calls and build the objection-handling playbook for our market — then drill it until it's reflexive.
Produce a video training series and self-serve modules with assessments, so new reps ramp fast and tenured reps keep sharpening.
qualifications: You'll thrive here if you
Have personally sold and closed — ideally outbound/high-volume B2B — and can show your numbers.
Write sales copy that converts and can explain  why  it works.
Are comfortable on camera and can produce clean training videos without a production team.
Can structure an A/B test, read the result honestly, and make the call.
Coach without crushing — you leave reps better and more confident.
Move fast: a diagnosis becomes a usable fix in hours, not weeks.
Know your way around a CRM (Hubspot plus) and a sales sequencing tool.
Nice to have

Experience in virtual staffing, BPO, or managed services · Pipedrive or CRM automations · video editing · sequencing tools (Apollo, Outreach, Salesloft, Instantly, Smartlead) · prior sales enablement assets (playbooks, battle cards, certification programs).

jobgether-jobgether:lever:0c4e3aed-99bd-.title: Director/Senior Director, Safety-PV Operations Lead
jobgether-jobgether:lever:0c4e3aed-99bd-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director/Senior Director, Safety-PV Operations Lead based in Switzerland. This is a senior pharmacovigilance leadership role responsible for shaping and executing global safety operations across late-stage clinical development and commercialization activities. You’ll own the operational safety model, ensuring it remains lean, agile, compliant, and capable of supporting complex global programs. The role combines strategic oversight with hands-on execution, including vendor management, safety documentation, signal management, and regulatory readiness. You’ll work closely with medical safety, regulatory, quality, biostatistics, medical writing, and external partners to maintain high standards of patient safety and compliance. The position offers significant influence over safety processes, governance, systems, and operational strategy within a fast-moving biotechnology environment. You’ll collaborate across North America, Europe, and Israel, working with distributed teams and external vendors in a highly flexible setting. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to global drug development while helping build scalable safety capabilities for future commercialization. Provide strategic direction for global safety and pharmacovigilance operations, ensuring an effective, compliant, and cost-efficient operating model. Develop, maintain, and oversee safety operational documents and agreements with external partners, including Joint Operating Guides, Safety Management Plans, and Safety Data Exchange Agreements. Coordinate the development of core safety documents, including DSURs, Reference Safety Information within Investigator’s Brochures, CCSI, and RMP/REMS materials, in collaboration with Regulatory Affairs. Coordinate high-quality safety outputs with Biostatistics, Quality Assurance, medical writing, and external vendors. Support ongoing safety surveillance, including signal management, risk assessment, and periodic safety reporting. Serve as the primary point of contact for safety vendors and CROs, managing work orders, budgets, deliverables, administrative requirements, and overall performance. Monitor vendor safety KPIs, ensure adherence to Safety Management Plans, and oversee implementation of required risk mitigation measures. Establish and maintain safety procedures, governance models, and SOPs appropriate to the stage of product development and future commercialization. Partner with Quality Assurance to ensure appropriate safety training is implemented, completed, and documented. Work closely with global medical safety leadership and represent safety operations in governance and decision-making forums. Collaborate with Regulatory Affairs, PV Quality Assurance, medical writing, and other internal functions to align safety expectations and maintain regulatory compliance. Represent safety operations in interactions with development and commercialization partners. Participate in clinical trial teams and expanded-access or compassionate-use programs as required. Requirements: Advanced degree such as a PhD, PharmD, MSc, or equivalent in a life-science or medical discipline. At least 5 years of experience in a comparable pharmacovigilance or safety operations leadership role, with experience across both small biotechnology and larger pharmaceutical organizations. Demonstrated experience supporting late-stage clinical development, initial commercialization, and compassionate-use or expanded-access programs. In-depth knowledge of global pharmacovigilance and safety requirements, including GVP and 21 CFR Part 11. Strong understanding of pre- and post-marketing safety requirements and global regulatory expectations. Experience creating and maintaining CCSI and initial RMP/REMS documentation. jobgether-jobgether:lever:1f9d7221-4b8c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Strong organizational, prioritization, and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and competing priorities. jobgether-jobgether:lever:2b0be95e-e4ea-.title: Head of Operations for eCom DTC brand
jobgether-jobgether:lever:2b0be95e-e4ea-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Operations for eCom DTC brand based in Luxembourg. This is a high-impact operations leadership role within a fast-growing, 8-figure direct-to-consumer business. You will take ownership of the operating infrastructure that supports supply chain, inventory, fulfillment, systems, reporting, hiring, and execution. The role is designed for a hands-on builder who can turn operational complexity into clear processes, accountable ownership, and measurable performance. You will identify gaps, build SOPs, establish systems, recruit functional leaders, and create the structure needed for sustainable scale. A major focus will be transitioning day-to-day operational responsibility away from the Founder and toward a capable team of independent functional owners. You will work across distributed teams, vendors, agencies, manufacturers, and operational partners in a highly entrepreneurial environment. Success means building an organization that runs efficiently, solves problems proactively, and no longer depends on you for daily execution. Own end-to-end back-end operations, including supply chain, inventory planning, manufacturing relationships, 3PL and fulfillment, returns, vendor management, and agency coordination. Build and maintain scalable operating systems, processes, and SOPs, ensuring every recurring workflow has clear ownership, documentation, measurement, and accountability. Establish and maintain an operational knowledge base in Notion, continuously improving processes as the business grows and new needs emerge. Develop accurate inventory systems of record, purchase-order calendars, and processes that improve inventory visibility, planning, and stock availability. Build reliable reporting and a single source of truth for weekly leadership metrics, including inventory, stockouts, cost per order, channel and subscription revenue, vendor performance, and other operational KPIs. Create automated subscription and channel revenue reporting and develop a concise weekly operations scorecard for leadership decision-making. Establish vendor and agency scorecards to monitor performance, identify issues, and drive continuous improvement. Identify missing organizational functions, define roles and scorecards, lead recruitment, conduct screening, onboard new hires, and develop functional owners. Build a team of 4–6 functional leaders who can independently own their respective areas and operate without daily intervention. Create repeatable hiring pipelines, work-sample assessments, onboarding systems, and accountability mechanisms. Translate decisions into clear written specifications with defined owners, deadlines, and completion criteria, then follow through until execution is complete. Diagnose operational issues by tracing performance changes back to their underlying causes and implementing sustainable solutions. Continuously identify and resolve operational problems before they escalate into Founder-level issues. Build the infrastructure and organizational capability required to ultimately transition into broader COO-level responsibilities. Requirements At least 3 years of operations experience within a physical-product, e-commerce, or direct-to-consumer business. Experience operating within a high-growth environment, ideally supporting or helping scale a brand generating approximately $20M–$50M in annual revenue. Direct experience across multiple operational functions, including supply chain, inventory, 3PL/fulfillment, customer support operations, creative, and growth teams. Demonstrated experience building a department, function, operating system, hiring process, reporting infrastructure, or other business capability from the ground up. Strong understanding of physical-product operations, including lead times, purchase orders, landed costs, inventory, fulfillment, manufacturing, and 3PL relationships.

Our partner is looking for a Engineering Manager, Identification Accuracy based in United States. This is a high-impact engineering leadership role at the intersection of machine learning, data science, and fraud prevention. You will lead a multidisciplinary team responsible for improving the accuracy and reliability of a critical identification platform. The role combines people leadership, technical strategy, and hands-on program direction in a globally distributed, fully remote environment. You’ll shape the team roadmap and guide the development of production ML systems operating at massive scale. Working closely with engineering, product, and customer-facing teams, you’ll translate business needs into meaningful technical priorities. Continuously improve engineering and ML practices, including experimentation, model evaluation, MLOps, data workflows, and operational processes. Demonstrated success building and developing high-performing multidisciplinary teams that include engineers, data scientists, analysts, or analytics engineers. Strong technical understanding of machine learning and data systems, with familiarity with MLOps practices and tooling such as experiment tracking, feature stores, model registries, and ML CI/CD pipelines. jobgether-jobgether:lever:dd807d56-1352-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Business Transformation & Operations based in Spain. This is a senior, high-ownership leadership role combining business transformation, operational excellence, client advisory, and commercial growth. You will diagnose complex organizational challenges across people, processes, technology, and management systems. The role goes beyond strategy, requiring you to turn recommendations into structured plans, implementation, training, and measurable outcomes. You will work directly with clients to understand their needs and shape engagements that address their most important business challenges. You will also contribute to proposals, presentations, business development, and closing new opportunities. Strong judgment and the confidence to constructively challenge senior leadership will be essential to driving meaningful change. This opportunity is particularly suited to an experienced transformation leader who wants broad ownership and the potential to grow into a General Manager-level role. Diagnose organizational performance and operating models across people, processes, technology, workflows, and management systems to identify root causes and improvement opportunities. Design and redesign organizational structures, workflows, processes, accountability models, and management systems to improve effectiveness and scalability. multiplierholdings-multiplier-holdings:a.description: Tech Lead Manager (Corporate Accounting Pod) Working Pattern: Full Time Reports to: Pod Lead Location: Singapore About the Company Multiplier Holdings is a VC-backed startup that acquires and scales high-impact professional services firms through AI and automation. Multiplier operates in high-stakes verticals like tax and corporate accounting, where complex workflows, regulatory requirements, and talent shortages create significant opportunities for automation. Unlike traditional software vendors, Multiplier integrates tech and service delivery under one roof. The company builds in-house AI and workflow components that can be configured to fit the needs of each acquired firm, increasing firm efficiency and productivity, while elevating the experience for both clients and staff. To learn more, visit multiplierholdings.com http://multiplierholdings.com. The Role The Tech Lead Manager (TLM) is a player-coach role. You will spend roughly half your time writing code and half your time leading a small sub-pod of two to three engineers. This is not a role where you manage from a distance; you are expected to stay close to the technical work and remain an active contributor. You will own a defined problem area within our Tax Pod or Corp Pod. Depending on where you land, that might mean building automated email and tax advice drafting, R&D tax credit workflows, practice management tooling, or working paper generation from accounting data. You scope the problem, set the technical direction, hire into the sub-pod, and drive it to outcomes. You will speak directly with our client firms. Understanding what they need, translating that into a build plan, and shipping it quickly is the core loop of this job. Key Responsibilities - Sub-pod ownership: Define the scope, roadmap, and delivery for a focused workflow area within the Tax or Corp pod. - Hands-on engineering: Write production code and remain an active technical contributor alongside your team. - Team building: Hire and develop a small sub-pod (~2 engineers), set expectations, and run a tight feedback loop. - Client engagement: Speak directly with firms and end users to understand problems, validate solutions, and gather fast feedback. - Technical direction: Make and own architecture and tooling decisions for your sub-pod's problem space. - Cross-pod coordination: Work with other TLMs, pod leads, and product to avoid duplication and align on shared components. - Rapid iteration: Scope tightly, ship quickly, and adjust based on what you observe in the field. - Quality and reliability: Maintain engineering standards appropriate to regulated, client-facing workflows. Who You Are - You have 7+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years in a lead or manager capacity. - You have shipped products end-to-end in a 0-to-1 environment, not just maintained or scaled existing systems. - You have managed engineers directly and have a track record of developing people, not just directing them. - You are comfortable talking to customers or clients and translating what you hear into a build plan. - You make decisions quickly with incomplete information and are prepared to own the outcome. - You have opinions about how to build, and you share them plainly without needing consensus on every point. - You are frustrated by slow shipping cycles and thrive when the feedback loop between build and customer is short. - You have worked in a domain with real compliance or operational stakes (tax, fintech, legal, accounting, or similar is a plus but not required). The firms you build for are live clients with immediate operational needs, which means your work has a direct, visible impact quickly. spmb-spmb:lever:0be1ebba-857b-40f9-8545-.description: About Us SPMB is a leading executive search firm at the heart of the innovation economy. We partner with transformative companies and investors to build the leadership teams that shape the future. For over 40 years, we’ve connected visionary executives with high-impact organizations across technology, financial services, consumer, media, health, and sustainability sectors. We combine the strategic reach of a global search firm with the agility and care of a boutique partnership. Our team closes hundreds of C-level and Board searches each year for the fastest-growing and most iconic companies in the world. These organizations have collectively generated more than $1 trillion in market value through IPOs and M&As. What truly sets SPMB apart is our culture. We’re a collaborative community of curious, driven people who believe in “We vs. I.” We challenge each other to work right, work together, and work smart that empowers everyone to grow, make an impact, and help shape the next generation of leadership. For more information, visit our website at https://spmb.com/ Position Overview As an Analyst at SPMB, you’ll be part of the engine that drives our client success, combining research, technology, and human insight to help build the leadership teams powering the world’s most innovative companies. This role offers an unparalleled opportunity to learn how successful leaders and organizations are built. You’ll collaborate with experienced search professionals and directly engage with senior executives, founders, and investors across venture capital, private equity, and public company ecosystems. We’re looking for curious problem-solvers who want their work to matter; people who take ownership, think critically, and embrace technology (including AI and large language models) to deepen insight and accelerate results. You’ll develop deep expertise in market dynamics, leadership trends, and organizational strategy while working in a culture that values continuous learning, teamwork, and purpose-driven impact. If you’re energized by discovery, driven by results, and ready to help shape the future of leadership, this is where your journey begins.
